Josh Gates investigates the mysteries behind lost, hidden, and missing treasures, uncovering clues and exploring the secrets behind legendary discoveries. From revealing the location of Forrest Fenn’s million-dollar buried treasure to investigating whether King Solomon’s mines ever existed and more!

About Expedition Files:
Josh Gates travels through history on a search to uncover new evidence and answers to unexplained mysteries, and true stories that defy explanation, offering revelations and new insights.
